image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a vintage audio cassette tape resting on a textured red surface. The cassette has a dark gray/black plastic body with a cream-colored paper label. Visible features include two circular spool windows revealing the tape reels, a central rectangular window showing the magnetic tape and a white pressure pad, and small molded details like screw holes and write-protect tabs along the bottom edge. There is faint, slightly distorted text on the label and a digital-style timestamp '2179 AM' in the bottom left corner, likely an artifact or overlay.
